questions.q: True or false? When the pivot comes short, first check if the marker follows.
questions.explain: Right, it's true. If the marker follows the pivot, the space behind opens for a runner.
choiceExplanations: Right, it's true. If the marker follows the pivot, the space behind opens for a runner.

questions.q: The right ala runs deep. What does the last defender do next?
options: Runs out to press the fixo
questions.explain: Yes. The last defender must protect the run, so they release the pivot.
choiceExplanations: Then the runner would be free behind them, heading straight at goal.
Yes. The last defender must protect the run, so they release the pivot.
The last defender cannot leave the space behind. The runner would be free to score.

questions.q: The pivot drops short on the left. Its marker follows. Where does the left ala run?
questions.explain: Yes. The marker left the space behind, so the left ala replaces the pivot's depth.
choiceExplanations: The pivot is already there. Two players close together are easy to mark.
Dropping back leaves nobody to use the empty space behind the defenders.
Yes. The marker left the space behind, so the left ala replaces the pivot's depth.
